findings.message: Entry param page (filter:caixaDespesasPendentes, persisted) had no state holding it; added public state 'page' (number | null) persisted in localStorage, written by qryInicio when not appending, and used as the initial page of the load.

The target page reads despesaId as a selection param but this page has no selection state; abrirAnaliseDespesas takes the picked despesaId as argument and carries only it (the page param of this list is not carried since it paginates a different list).
public page is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
